description: Router feature - Map HTTP request paths to markdown files in the root directory with proper error handling and URL normalization

userStories.title: Extract file path from request
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to parse the request path and extract the markdown file path relative to the root directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Reject paths containing '..' sequences (prevent directory traversal)
userStories.notes: Implemented in Program.cs Content() method. Handles query strings, trailing slashes, URL decoding, path traversal protection, and file existence checking.

userStories.title: Normalize request paths
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to normalize paths by removing trailing slashes for consistent routing.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove trailing slash from paths (except root '/')

userStories.title: Handle file requests
userStories.description: As a user, I want to request a markdown file by its path and get its content.
acceptanceCriteria: Return 200 OK with markdown content for valid paths
Read file content using FileSystem or similar
userStories.notes: File requests handled in Program.cs Content() method. Reads .md files and returns content with 200 status. Also handles directory default files (index.md).

userStories.title: Handle missing files with 404
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive an error response when requesting a non-existent file.
acceptanceCriteria: Request '/sample/folder/' where folder doesn't exist returns 404
userStories.notes: 404 handling implemented in Program.cs Content() method. Sets Response.StatusCode = 404 and returns '404 Not Found' message for missing files and directories without index.md.

userStories.title: Serve directory default file
userStories.description: As a user, I want to access a directory and have its index.md served automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: Request '/sample/topic/' returns content of 'sample/topic/index.md' if it exists
If no 'index.md' exists in the directory, return 404
Check for index.md when path resolves to a directory
userStories.notes: Directory default file handling implemented in Program.cs Content() method (lines 96-113). When a path resolves to a directory, checks for index.md and returns it if exists, otherwise returns 404.

userStories.title: Validate path is within root directory
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to ensure security by preventing path traversal attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate resolved path is within root directory
Reject paths that escape root directory bounds
Use Path.GetFullPath and compare against root
